items.source: Can be subclassed to override requiresRefresh() to suppress unnecessary refreshes. By default, a refresh will be performed every time the "refreshCheckDelay" has elapsed.
items.translation: 可以子类化以重写 `requiresRefresh()` 来抑制不必要的刷新。默认情况下，每当“refreshCheckDelay”时间间隔过后将执行一次刷新。

items.source:
Note that the passed-in BeanFactory should have an appropriate
bean definition set up for the given bean name.
items.translation: 请注意，传入的 BeanFactory 应为给定的 bean 名称设置了适当的 bean 定义。

items.source:
This default implementation fetches a new target bean
instance from the bean factory.
items.translation: 该默认实现从 Bean 工厂获取新的目标 Bean 实例。

items.source: beanFactory - the BeanFactory to fetch beans from
items.translation: beanFactory - 用于获取 Bean 的 BeanFactory

items.source: Rob Harrop, Rod Johnson, Juergen Hoeller, Mark Fisher
items.translation: Rob Harrop, Rod Johnson, Juergen Hoeller, Mark Fisher

items.source:
Create a new BeanFactoryRefreshableTargetSource for the given
bean factory and bean name.
items.translation: 为给定的 bean 工厂和 bean 名称创建一个新的 BeanFactoryRefreshableTargetSource。

items.source:
A template method that subclasses may override to provide a
fresh target object for the given bean factory and bean name.
items.translation: 子类可以重写此模板方法，为给定的 Bean 工厂和 Bean 名称提供一个新的目标对象。

items.source: beanName - the name of the target bean
